name: Only Dwarves Dig Proper Holes
summary:
You’re a dwarf. You dig holes. That’s the job.


Hold on to your beard and get to work, because there’s a whole lot of ground beneath your feet and absolutely no reason to stop digging. 

What’s down there? Probably treasure. Or doom. Or both. The only way to know for sure is to try...   You’ve got a shovel, no help, no light, no plan. What are you waiting for ?
